name: Crisp stream fish
summary: Cá suối rán giòn is crisp-fried stream fish on the national Sa Pa list. The fish and the batter were not described. Anh Dũng also names cá suối.
origin: The national Sa Pa food paragraph, with bánh ngô, bánh đao, and bánh dầy.
howToEat: In Sa Pa, it comes fried until crisp.

In Mai Châu, the 2019 feature says cá suối is a shared name for small fish such as cá bống and cá quả, fried or grilled, and that the bones can be eaten. It is not on the table every day. Cá suối chiên stays its own plate.
where: In Sa Pa, Anh Dũng at 06 Xuân Viên lists cá suối.
In Mai Châu, Pom Coọng names cá suối, and a Báo Phú Thọ guest meal names cá nướng. The hour is Check on arrival.
